resources.string: Tap your phone on an NFC sticker to start focusing. Distracting apps stay blocked until you walk back and tap again.\n\nStarting is easy. Stopping takes a deliberate step.

Anchor uses an Accessibility service to block apps during your focus sessions.

• What it sees: the name of the app on screen (including split-screen and picture-in-picture windows). It never reads what is on screen, what you type, or your messages.
• Why: to cover apps you chose to block and to count how often you opened them.
• Where it goes: nowhere. Anchor has no internet access; everything stays on this phone.

You can turn it off at any time in Settings › Accessibility.

In Settings, open Installed apps (or Downloaded apps), tap Anchor app blocking and turn it on. Then come back here.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out, open Anchor in Settings › Apps, tap ⋮ and choose Allow restricted settings first.
